root_keys.name: fg_schedule
root_keys.note: No aliases accepted; key is checked by exact name. Duplicate (date, line, model) rows are summed.

fields.name: date
fields.note: Accessed as row['date'] (KeyError if absent). Normalised by _norm_date: also accepts YYYY/MM/DD and YYYY.MM.DD. Range 2025-08-01 to 2025-08-31.

fields.name: line
fields.note: Accessed as str(row['line']).strip() (KeyError if absent). Expected values: '1#' / '2#' / '3#'.

fields.name: model
fields.note: Accessed as str(row['model']).strip() (KeyError if absent). Expected values: '101A' through '110A'. Together with date and line forms the composite accumulation key.

fields.name: qty
fields.note: Accessed via row.get('qty', 0); defaults to 0 if absent. Converted with int(round(float(...))). Negative values are not truncated at parsing but effectively penalised downstream.

root_keys.name: semi_schedule
root_keys.note: No aliases accepted; key is checked by exact name. Duplicate (date, semi) rows are summed.

fields.name: date
fields.note: Accessed as row['date'] (KeyError if absent). Normalised by _norm_date. Range 2025-07-31 to 2025-08-31 (includes lead-time pre-day 7/31).

fields.name: semi
fields.note: Accessed as str(row['semi']).strip() (KeyError if absent). Expected values: 'AA' / 'BB' / 'CC'. Together with date forms the composite accumulation key.

fields.name: self_qty
fields.note: Accessed via row.get('self_qty', 0); defaults to 0 if absent. Converted with int(round(float(...))). Daily in-house production quantity.

fields.name: buy_qty
fields.note: Accessed via row.get('buy_qty', 0); defaults to 0 if absent. Converted with int(round(float(...))). Daily purchased quantity; semantically meaningful only for semi='BB' rows.
